name: Eryl
description: Handles semantic questions end-to-end: retrieves supporting context from Azure Cognitive Search via vector/semantic search, generates a context-grounded answer, and critiques that answer for quality — looping back to Eryl_agent for another retrieval round on failure.

sub_agents.name: Eryl_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Selector agent: forwards the current question (or critic feedback_query on retry) to the retriever via extract_context.

sub_agents.name: retriever
sub_agents.purpose: Executes extract_context and passes retrieved chunks to llm_answer_maker.

sub_agents.name: llm_answer_maker
sub_agents.purpose: Generates a detailed answer strictly from the retrieved context; states insufficient-context explicitly rather than guessing.

sub_agents.name: critic_agent
sub_agents.purpose: Scores the semantic answer on five dimensions; on FAIL produces feedback_query and loops back to Eryl_agent; on PASS appends the literal phrase 'Happy with the answer' and terminates.

tools.name: extract_context
tools.description: Embeds the question (Azure OpenAI) and runs a semantic/vector search against Azure Cognitive Search. Returns {"vector_context": [chunk, ...]}.

handoff_note: user_proxy is owned by the GroupChat in agent.py (standalone) or by the parent orchestrator when ErylChainRunner is used. The SQL-driven query_transformer step has been removed.

external_resources: Azure OpenAI (GPT-4-class chat deployment + embedding deployment)
Azure Cognitive Search (SearchClient via AZURE_SEARCH_SERVICE_ENDPOINT + AZURE_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME)

statefulness: agent.py builds module-level AssistantAgent instances and a GroupChat at import time. Prefer ErylChainRunner.run / get_answer as the public entrypoint for reuse. build_agents() in chain_helpers returns the live module-level agents for orchestrator compatibility.
